name: core-runtime-approval-local-engine-full
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves deterministic local Approval.process engine behavior and makes zero Salesforce workflow parity claim.

evidence.notes: Seeded ProcessDefinition and ProcessNode records drive deterministic local approval submission.
Seeded ProcessInstanceWorkitem records support local approve and reject actions; missing metadata with allOrNone=false returns a failed ProcessResult.
Executable local deterministic engine proof for typed submit requests.
Executable local deterministic engine proof for typed submit requests with allOrNone.
Executable local deterministic engine proof for typed workitem requests.
Executable local deterministic engine proof for typed workitem requests with allOrNone.
Executable local deterministic engine proof for typed submit request lists.
Executable local deterministic engine proof for typed workitem request lists.

source.content: Account approved = new Account(Name = 'Approve Me'); insert approved; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest submitApprove = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); submitApprove.setObjectId(approved.Id); submitApprove.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); submitApprove.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessResult submittedApprove = Approval.process(submitApprove); System.assertEquals(true, submittedApprove.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Pending', submittedApprove.getInstanceStatus()); System.assertEquals(1, submittedApprove.getNewWorkitemIds().size()); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest approve = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); approve.setWorkitemId(submittedApprove.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); approve.setAction('Approve'); Approval.ProcessResult approvedResult = Approval.process(approve); System.assertEquals(true, approvedResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Approved', approvedResult.getInstanceStatus()); Account rejected = new Account(Name = 'Reject Me'); insert rejected; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest submitReject = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); submitReject.setObjectId(rejected.Id); submitReject.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); submitReject.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessResult submittedReject = Approval.process(submitReject); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest reject = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); reject.setWorkitemId(submittedReject.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); reject.setAction('Reject'); Approval.ProcessResult rejectedResult = Approval.process(reject); System.assertEquals('Rejected', rejectedResult.getInstanceStatus()); Contact missing = new Contact(LastName = 'No Metadata'); insert missing; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest missingRequest = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); Approval.ProcessResult missingResult = Approval.process(missingRequest, false); System.assertEquals(false, missingResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, missingResult.getErrors().size()); Account single = new Account(Name = 'Typed Single'); insert single; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest singleSubmit = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); singleSubmit.setObjectId(single.Id); singleSubmit.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); singleSubmit.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessResult singleResult = Approval.process(singleSubmit); System.assertEquals(true, singleResult.isSuccess()); Account singleBool = new Account(Name = 'Typed Single Boolean'); insert singleBool; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest singleBoolSubmit = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); singleBoolSubmit.setObjectId(singleBool.Id); singleBoolSubmit.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); singleBoolSubmit.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessResult singleBoolResult = Approval.process(singleBoolSubmit, false); System.assertEquals(true, singleBoolResult.isSuccess()); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest work = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); work.setWorkitemId(singleResult.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); work.setAction('Approve'); Approval.ProcessResult workResult = Approval.process(work); System.assertEquals('Approved', workResult.getInstanceStatus()); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest workBool = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); workBool.setWorkitemId(singleBoolResult.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); workBool.setAction('Approve'); Approval.ProcessResult workBoolResult = Approval.process(workBool, false); System.assertEquals('Approved', workBoolResult.getInstanceStatus()); Account listFirst = new Account(Name = 'Typed List First'); insert listFirst; Account listSecond = new Account(Name = 'Typed List Second'); insert listSecond; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest firstRequest = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); firstRequest.setObjectId(listFirst.Id); firstRequest.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); firstRequest.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest secondRequest = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); secondRequest.setObjectId(listSecond.Id); secondRequest.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); secondRequest.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); List<Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest> submits = new List<Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest>{ firstRequest, secondRequest }; List<Approval.ProcessResult> submitResults = Approval.process(submits); System.assertEquals(2, submitResults.size()); List<Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest> works = new List<Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest>(); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest firstWork = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); firstWork.setWorkitemId(submitResults.get(0).getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); firstWork.setAction('Approve'); works.add(firstWork); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest secondWork = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); secondWork.setWorkitemId(submitResults.get(1).getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); secondWork.setAction('Approve'); works.add(secondWork); List<Approval.ProcessResult> workResults = Approval.process(works); System.assertEquals(2, workResults.size()); System.assertEquals('Approved', workResults.get(0).getInstanceStatus()); System.assertEquals('Approved', workResults.get(1).getInstanceStatus());
